read_file_contents: read the contents of a file using ReadFile and return its text or None on error
read_file_with_error_suppression: read a file using ReadFile with print_error set to False to suppress IOError messages
read_cpp_source_file: read a C++ source file using ReadFile to get its full text content for parsing
check_debug_flag: check the DEBUG module-level constant to see if token index debugging is enabled
read_file_and_parse: read a file with ReadFile then parse its contents for C++ tokens or structures
